Time Window Resource Get Time Windows
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/timeWindows

Gets a list of time intervals used for by the Firewall policy or the URL Filtering policy.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32
name
string
startTime
int32
endTime
int32
dayOfWeek
string[]

Possible values: [ANY, NONE, EVERYDAY, SUN, MON, TUE, WED, THU, FRI, SAT]

]
